DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園での観察について、何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with observations in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池で見た鳥の数を記録したいです。同じ鳥を二回数えたかもしれないので、どう書くか相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園で見た鳥の数を観察記録に書きたいので、同じ鳥を重複して数えた可能性を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to record the number of birds I saw at the pond. I may have counted the same birds twice. Could I ask how to write that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the possibility of double-counting the same birds when recording the number you saw in the park. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、どの場所でご覧になりましたか。二回の観察を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: When and where did you see them? Please describe the two observations separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時に池の端で十羽、十時十分に同じ場所で十羽見ました。一度飛んで見えなくなったので、同じ群れが戻った可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池の同じ場所で十時と十時十分にそれぞれ十羽見たが、移動して戻った同じ群れかもしれないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saw ten at the edge of the pond at ten o'clock and ten in the same place at ten past ten. They flew out of sight in between, so the same flock may have returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw ten birds at the same pond location at ten o'clock and ten past ten, but it may have been the same flock returning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の群れだと確認できる特徴はありましたか。見た数を足す前に、その点を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Were there distinguishing features confirming they were different flocks? Let us clarify that before adding the numbers together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 個体を見分ける印はわかりません。別の二群とは確認できないので、時刻ごとに十羽見たと記録したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 個体を見分ける印は分からず、別の二群とは確認できないので、観察時刻ごとの数を記録したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not know any markings that distinguish individual birds. I cannot confirm two separate flocks, so I want to record seeing ten at each observation time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot distinguish individual birds or confirm two separate flocks, so you want to record the count for each observation time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら観察した事実が伝わります。場所も示し、見えなかった間の動きは推測と区別してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will convey what you actually observed. Include the location too and distinguish any guesses about their movements while out of sight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この案内図で見た位置を示します。見失った間にどこへ行ったかは書かず、二回の群れが同じかは不明と添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時刻と場所を案内図で示し、見失った間の行動を推測で足さず、群れの関係は不明と書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will mark the observation location on this map. I will not write where they went while out of sight, and will add that I do not know whether the two flocks were the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate the times and location using the map, and say you will not add guessed movements while the birds were out of sight and will note that the relationship between the flocks is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録を提出する場合は、受付の書き方も確認できます。確かめられない総数を無理に決める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you submit the record, you can also check the submission format at reception. You do not need to force a total that you cannot verify.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二十羽いたとは書かず、二回それぞれ十羽見たと報告します。同じ群れかどうかは不明だと分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二十羽いたとはせず、二回それぞれ十羽見たことと同じ群れか不明なことを分けて報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not write that there were twenty birds. I will report seeing ten on each of two occasions and separately explain that I do not know whether they were the same flock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not report twenty birds, but will separately report seeing ten on each occasion and not knowing whether it was the same flock. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。観察時刻と場所を添えてご相談ください。記録へのご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please include the observation times and location when seeking advice. Thank you for contributing your records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご乗車について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 登別から大きいかばんを持って乗ります。同行者と離れず、邪魔にならない持ち方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重いかばんを持って乗るので、同行者と離れず周囲の邪魔にならない運び方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will board at Noboribetsu with a large bag. I would like advice on carrying it without getting separated from my companion or inconveniencing others.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to carry a heavy bag when boarding without becoming separated from your companion or obstructing others. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: かばんは一つですか。お二人で運べる大きさでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have one bag? Is it a size the two of you can carry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つですが重いです。私が持ち、同行者には扉の周りを確かめてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かばんは重い一つで、自分が持ち同行者には扉付近の様子を確認してもらいたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is just one, but it is heavy. I want to carry it myself and have my companion check the area around the doors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have one heavy bag, will carry it yourself, and want your companion to check around the doors. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 扉や通路をふさがないようにしてください。乗る前に、お二人で待つ位置も決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not block the doors or aisle. Before boarding, decide where the two of you will wait too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先にかばんだけ置いて座席を探すのはやめます。二人で一緒に乗り、必要なら係員へ置き場所を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かばんだけ先に置いて席を探さず、二人で一緒に乗り、必要なら係員に置き場所を尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not put the bag down first and then look for seats. We will board together and ask a staff member where to put it if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not leave the bag first to look for seats, will board together, and will ask staff where to put it if necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物を放置せず、ご自身で管理してください。離れた場合の待ち合わせも決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not leave your luggage unattended; keep it under your own supervision. Have you also decided where to meet if separated?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 無理に車内を追いかけず、次に安全に話せる時に連絡します。同行者の切符は本人が持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 離れた場合は車内で追いかけず安全に連絡できる時に話し、切符は各自で持っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will not force our way through the train to chase each other. We will contact each other when it is next safe to talk. My companion has their own ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if separated, you will not chase each other through the train but talk when it is safe to contact each other, and that each person has their own ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら切符も各自で確認できますね。乗降の際は、周囲の方の動きを見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then you can each check your own ticket. Please watch the movements of people around you when boarding and alighting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一緒に乗って荷物を手元で管理します。扉をふさがず、置き場所に迷ったら係員へ尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一緒に乗って荷物を手元で管理し、扉をふさがず置き場所に迷ったら係員へ聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will board together and keep the luggage with us. We will not block the doors and will ask staff if unsure where to put it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will board together, keep the luggage with you, avoid blocking doors, and ask staff if unsure where to put it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。周囲に気をつけてご乗車ください。よい旅を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please be mindful of those around you when boarding. Have a good journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。生活の相談で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with everyday-life advice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の後に日本語を勉強したいです。登別で参加できる学習の相談先を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事の後に日本語を学びたいので、参加できる学習機会の相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to study Japanese after work. Could you tell me whom to contact about learning opportunities I can join in Noboribetsu?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whom to contact about available learning opportunities because you want to study Japanese after work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 参加できる曜日や時間は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which days and times you can attend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜勤があるので毎週同じ曜日には来られません。月ごとの勤務表を見て参加日を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夜勤で毎週同じ曜日には来られず、月ごとの勤務表を見て参加日を決めたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I work night shifts, so I cannot attend on the same day every week. I want to choose attendance dates after checking each month's work schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that night shifts prevent you from attending on the same weekday every week and you want to decide dates based on your monthly work schedule. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 学習先に、参加の頻度や申込み方法を確認しましょう。特に練習したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the learning provider about attendance frequency and how to apply. Is there anything in particular you want to practice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 職場で作業の遅れを説明する練習です。試験だけの授業より、生活や仕事の会話もあるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場で作業の遅れを説明する練習をしたく、試験対策だけでなく生活や仕事の会話も学べるか知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Explaining delays in work at my workplace. I would like to know whether there is everyday and workplace conversation rather than only exam-focused classes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to practice explaining work delays and know whether everyday and workplace conversation are taught as well as exam preparation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 希望する内容を伝えて相談できます。お問い合わせは電話でできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can explain those preferences when asking. Are you able to inquire by phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話は聞き取りが不安です。メールで勤務表の空いている日と希望を送りたいので、連絡先を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話の聞き取りが不安なので、空いている日と学習希望をメールで送りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am worried about understanding over the phone. I want to email my available dates from my work schedule and my preferences, so I would like to confirm the contact address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are worried about understanding phone conversations and want to email your available dates and learning preferences. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 学習先から条件の回答が来ました。毎週参加は必須ではなく、単発の参加を相談でき、職場の報告練習もできます。申込みは、この案内のメール宛先へ希望日を送る方法です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The learning provider has replied about the conditions. Weekly attendance is not required, occasional attendance can be discussed, and you can practice workplace reporting. To apply, send your preferred dates to the email address in this information sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 毎週でなく単発を相談でき、報告練習もできるのですね。勤務表全体は送らず、空いている日と、作業の遅れを説明する練習希望だけを案内のメール宛先へ送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単発参加と職場報告練習が可能という回答を確認し、全勤務表でなく空き日と作業遅れの説明練習希望を案内のメールへ送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: So I can discuss occasional rather than weekly attendance and practice reporting too. I will not send my entire work schedule, only my available dates and my wish to practice explaining work delays to the email address in the information sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that occasional attendance and workplace-reporting practice are possible, and say you will email only available dates and your request to practice explaining work delays rather than the whole work schedule. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申込み方法と練習内容を確認できました。参加日を確定したわけではないので、送信後は学習先の返事をお待ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed how to apply and the practice content. Attendance dates are not confirmed, so please await the learning provider's reply after sending your message. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 呼出しの声が聞き取りにくいです。自分の順番を逃さないため、別の確認方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 呼出しが聞き取りにくいため、自分の順番を逃さない別の確認方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I find it hard to hear the calls. I would like to discuss another way to check so I do not miss my turn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you find the calls hard to hear and want another way to check so you do not miss your turn. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 聞こえづらいのは待合室の放送でしょうか。文字の表示なら確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it the waiting-room announcements that are hard to hear? Could you check a written display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 放送が小さく感じます。文字は読めるので、受付番号が表示される場所を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 放送が小さく感じるが文字は読めるので、受付番号の表示場所を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The announcements sound quiet to me. I can read text, so I would like to see where the reception numbers are displayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the announcements sound quiet but you can read text and want to check where reception numbers are displayed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付票の番号は074です。右側の青い画面に、診察室へ案内する番号が表示されます。画面正面の椅子から見えますが、文字の大きさは確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your reception number is 074. The blue screen on the right displays numbers being directed to the examination rooms. You can see it from the chairs facing the screen, but could you check whether the text is large enough?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 周りに聞こえる声で事情を説明するのは避けたいです。受付では筆談で相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 周囲に聞こえる声で事情を話すのは避けたいので、受付では筆談で相談できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would prefer not to explain my situation out loud where people around me can hear. Can we communicate in writing at reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can communicate in writing at reception because you would prefer not to explain your situation within others' hearing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらの紙で筆談できます。声ではなく、番号の確認方法も書いてお渡しします。今日は同行する方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we can use this paper to communicate. I will also write down how to check your number instead of explaining aloud. Is anyone accompanying you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一人です。誰かにずっと聞いてもらう方法ではなく、自分で番号を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は一人で、他の人に聞いてもらい続けるのではなく、自分で番号を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am alone today. Rather than relying on someone to keep listening for me, I want to check the number myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are alone today and want to check the number yourself rather than have another person keep listening for you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で青い画面を見ていただけます。074が消えてしまった時は、受付へこの票を見せてください。職員が現在の案内を確認して、紙でお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can watch the blue screen yourself. If 074 has disappeared, please show this slip at reception. Staff will check the current instructions and tell you in writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 074を青い画面で確認して、画面正面の椅子で待ちます。番号を見逃したら、この票を受付で見せます。紙の説明も受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 074を青い画面で確認して正面の椅子で待ち、見逃したら受付票を見せると復唱し、紙の説明を受け取ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check 074 on the blue screen and wait in a chair facing it. If I miss the number, I will show this slip at reception. I have received the written instructions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will check 074 on the blue screen, wait in a chair facing it, and show your reception slip if you miss the number. Say you have received the written instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、筆談の紙と受付票をお持ちください。呼出しを見逃した場合も、その票で受付にお知らせいただけます。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please keep the written communication sheet and reception slip with you. Even if you miss the call, you can use that slip to tell reception. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道に大きい箱が落ちていました。車の通る所なので、拾いに行かず場所を知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車が通る道に大きな箱が落ちているため、拾いに行かず場所を知らせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a large box lying in the road. Cars travel there, so I would like to report its location rather than go to pick it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a large box is lying in a road used by cars and you want to report its location without going to pick it up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は安全な場所にいますか。位置を説明できる目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you in a safe place now? Is there a landmark you can use to describe the location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩道にいます。交差点の手前で、近くの建物の看板をここから読めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩道にいて、交差点の手前の位置と近くの建物の看板を安全な場所から確認できると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am on the sidewalk. It is just before an intersection, and I can read a sign on a nearby building from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are on the sidewalk and can safely identify the position before the intersection and the sign on a nearby building. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車道には出ず、見える目印を教えてください。箱の中身はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Stay out of the roadway and tell us the landmarks you can see. Do you know what is inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中身は見ていません。開いていない箱なので危険物ではないと決めず、外から見えた大きさだけ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱は閉じていて中身は不明なので安全とは決めつけず、外から見えた大きさを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not seen inside. It is closed, so I will not assume it contains nothing dangerous. I will only describe the size I could see from outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the box is closed and its contents unknown, so you will not assume it is safe and will describe the size visible from outside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる外見で十分です。ほかの方が避けて通っている様子はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The appearance you can verify is enough. Are other people going around it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 車が箱を避けています。自分で車を誘導せず、歩道から知らせています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車が箱を避けて通っているが、自分で車を誘導せず歩道から報告していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Cars are going around the box. I am reporting from the sidewalk without trying to direct traffic myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that cars are going around the box and that you are reporting from the sidewalk without directing traffic yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 安全な位置を保ってください。担当へ場所と通行の状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please remain in a safe position. I will tell the person in charge its location and the traffic situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 看板と交差点の位置、車が避けていることを伝えます。箱へ近づかず、指示があればここから答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 看板と交差点の位置、車が避けている状況を示し、箱に近づかず安全な場所から答えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will describe the sign, its position relative to the intersection, and the cars going around it. I will not approach the box and will answer from here if instructed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the sign, intersection location and cars avoiding the box, and say you will answer from a safe place without approaching the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お知らせありがとうございます。安全な場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for letting us know. Please wait in a safe place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お手紙の発送で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you mail your letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お世話になった方へ礼状と写真を送りたいです。写真を折らずに入れる封筒を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 礼状と写真を送りたいので、写真を折らずに入れられる封筒について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to send a thank-you letter and photos to someone who has helped me. Could I ask about an envelope that holds the photos without folding them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an envelope that can hold photos unfolded because you want to send a thank-you letter and photos. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の大きさと枚数を見せてください。便箋は何枚ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the photo size and number. How many sheets of letter paper do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真は二枚、便箋は一枚です。写真はこの大きさで、便箋だけ折って入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真は二枚、便箋は一枚で、写真の大きさを示し便箋だけを折りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two photos and one sheet of letter paper. The photos are this size, and I want to fold only the letter paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have two photos and one sheet of letter paper, show the photo size, and explain that you want to fold only the letter paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真二枚は折らず、便箋一枚だけを折るのですね。今の封筒では写真の端が当たっています。写真を平らに入れられる大きい方の封筒を比べ、厚紙を含めた完成時の寸法と重さを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the two photos will stay flat, and only the one sheet of letter paper will be folded. The photo edges touch the sides of your current envelope. Let us compare a larger envelope that holds the photos flat, then check the finished dimensions and weight including stiff cardboard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 厚紙を入れたいです。封筒に入れば料金が同じとは思わず、全部入れた状態で見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 厚紙も入れたいので、封筒に入れば同じ料金とは考えず、全て入れた状態で確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to include cardboard. I will not assume the postage stays the same just because everything fits in the envelope; I would like you to check it with everything inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to include cardboard and ask for a check with everything inside, without assuming the price stays the same just because it fits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 完成した状態で確認できます。中の写真には説明を書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check the completed package. Will you add explanations to the photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真の裏を直接強く書かず、別の紙に撮った時の説明を付けます。相手がわかる順に二枚を並べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真の裏に強く書かず別紙に撮影時の説明を付け、相手に分かる順で二枚を並べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not press hard writing directly on the backs of the photos. I will add a separate sheet describing when they were taken and arrange the two photos in an order the recipient can understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not write hard on the photo backs, will add a separate explanation of when they were taken, and arrange the two in an understandable order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備ができたら、宛先と封の状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once it is ready, please check the address and that the envelope is properly sealed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 便箋、二枚の写真、説明、厚紙を入れて持ってきます。完成時の大きさと重さで発送方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 便箋、写真、説明、厚紙を用意し、完成時の寸法と重さで発送方法を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring it with the letter paper, two photos, explanation and cardboard inside. I want to check the mailing method based on its finished size and weight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare the letter paper, photos, explanation and cardboard and want to check the mailing method based on the finished dimensions and weight. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備が整いましたらお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it when it is ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。記録の確認で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you check your records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面の文字が小さいので、口座の明細を紙で読みたいです。月ごとに見られる方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 画面の文字が小さいため明細を紙で読み、月ごとに確認する方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The text on the screen is small, so I would like to read my account statements on paper. I want to discuss a way to check them month by month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to read account statements on paper and check them month by month because the screen text is small. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要なのはどの期間ですか。印刷方法も担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which period do you need? We can also ask the person in charge about printing methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今年の一月から三月です。三か月まとめてではなく、一か月ずつ比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今年の一月から三月を対象に、まとめた合計だけでなく月別に比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: January through March this year. I want to compare one month at a time rather than have all three months combined.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want January through March this year and to compare them month by month rather than only see a combined total. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望は一月、二月、三月の三つの期間を別々に読むことですね。合計だけの画面ではなく、各月の入出金一覧を希望すると担当へ伝えます。発行できる形式と費用はまだ未確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You want to read January, February and March as three separate periods. I will tell the person in charge you want a list of deposits and withdrawals for each month rather than a screen showing only totals. The available formats and fees are still unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家計を手伝う家族に見せます。でも口座の番号まで全部写して渡す必要があるかは考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家計を手伝う家族に見せたいが、口座番号まで全て写して渡す必要があるか考えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will show them to a family member who helps with household finances. But I want to consider whether I need to give them copies that include my full account number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to show them to a family member who helps with household finances but want to consider whether copies need to include the full account number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報を整理し、紙の保管にも注意してください。元の記録を失わず、ご自身で確認できるようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Organize the information you need and take care when storing the paper. Keep the original records so you can check them yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分用の原記録は保管し、家族と話す時は必要な入出金を整理した表を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の記録は自分で保管し、家族とは必要な入出金を整理した表を使って話したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to keep my own original records and use a table of the necessary deposits and withdrawals when discussing them with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the original records yourself and discuss the finances with your family using a table of the necessary deposits and withdrawals. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当への質問は「三か月分を月別の紙で出せるか」「費用はいくらか」の二点として控えました。ご家族用には元の紙を丸ごと渡さず、必要な項目を別表にまとめたい、という希望も整理できています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have noted two questions for the person in charge: whether three months can be issued on paper separated by month, and how much it costs. We have also clarified that you want a separate table of needed items for your family rather than hand over the original papers in full.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三か月を月別で読む方法と費用を聞きます。原記録は自分で保管し、相談には必要な項目の表を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三か月を月別に読む方法と費用を聞き、元の記録は保管して相談には必要な項目の表を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask how to read the three months separately and about the fee. I will keep the original records myself and use a table of the needed items for the discussion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask about the method and cost of reading three months separately, keep the original records, and use a table of necessary items for the discussion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。食材選びで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you choose ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スープに入れる香味野菜を探しています。生の物を全部そろえるのが難しいので、別の候補も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: スープ用の香味野菜を探しているが、生の材料を全てそろえるのが難しいので別の候補も見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for aromatic vegetables for soup. It is hard to get all the fresh ingredients together, so I would like to look at alternatives too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are looking for aromatic vegetables for soup but find it hard to obtain all the fresh ingredients, so you want to see alternatives too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 普段はどのような材料を使いますか。今日は何人分作りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: What ingredients do you usually use? How many people are you cooking for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普段は二種類使いますが、今日は一人分です。余りを使う予定がなく、少量で作りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 普段は二種類使うが今日は一人分で、余りを使う予定がないため少量で作りたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I normally use two kinds, but today it is just for one person. I have no plans to use leftovers, so I want to make a small amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you normally use two kinds but are cooking for one today and want a small amount because you have no plans for leftovers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 少量の商品や乾燥品の表示を比べられます。料理の手順も商品ごとに確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can compare labels on small-quantity products and dried ingredients. Please check each product's preparation instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乾燥品を同じ量だけ入れるとは考えず、使い方の表示を読みたいです。味付け済みかも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乾燥品を生の野菜と同じ量では使わず、使用方法と味付け済みかを表示で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume I should add the same quantity of dried ingredients. I want to read the instructions and check whether they are already seasoned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not use dried ingredients in the same quantity as fresh vegetables and want to check the usage instructions and whether they are seasoned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原材料や使用方法を確かめましょう。別の料理でも使えるか考えて選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the ingredients and instructions. You can also consider whether you could use them in other dishes when choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 調味料が入っている物なら、いつもの味付けをそのまま重ねないようにします。まず少ない品数の献立へ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 調味料入りなら普段の味付けをそのまま足さず、まず少ない品数の献立に変えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If a product already contains seasonings, I will avoid simply adding my usual seasoning on top. First, I want to change to a menu with fewer dishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if the product contains seasonings you will not simply add your usual seasoning, and first want a menu with fewer dishes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示を見て、ご自身の作り方に合う品をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Read the labels and choose products that suit the way you cook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一人分で使いやすい候補を比べます。乾燥品の使い方と味付けを読み、全部の生野菜を無理に買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一人分で使いやすい候補を比べ、乾燥品の使い方と味付けを読み、生の材料を無理に全て買わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will compare options that are easy to use for one person. I will read the dried ingredients' instructions and seasoning information without forcing myself to buy every fresh vegetable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare options suitable for one person, read the dried ingredients' usage and seasoning information, and not force yourself to buy all the fresh ingredients. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示で迷ったらお声がけください。お買い物ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask if you are unsure about a label. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。清掃活動で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with the cleanup activity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて参加します。どこを掃除し、わからない物を見つけた時に誰へ聞くか教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めて清掃活動に参加するので、作業範囲と不明な物を見つけた場合の報告先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first time participating. Could you tell me which area to clean and whom to ask if I find something I am unsure about?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your assigned cleanup area and whom to report unfamiliar items to because this is your first time participating. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 参加受付は済みましたか。担当の説明は聞きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you registered? Have you heard the person in charge's explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付は済みましたが、途中から来たので説明を聞いていません。ほかの人を見てまねする前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付は済んだが途中参加で説明を聞けず、周囲をまねする前に説明を受けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have registered, but I arrived partway through and missed the explanation. I want to ask before copying what others do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you registered but missed the explanation because you joined partway through, and want instructions before copying others. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明は私からお伝えします。担当は地図のA区画の舗装通路で、拾うのは紙ごみだけです。道路側や植込みへは入らず、始める前に受付で道具と報告の方法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will explain. You are assigned the paved path in section A on the map, and you should pick up only paper litter. Do not go into the road-side area or planted areas. Before starting, check the equipment and reporting method at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使う袋と手袋も確認します。割れた物や中身のわからない容器は、自分で開けず担当へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋と手袋を確認し、割れた物や中身が不明な容器は自分で開けず担当者へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check the bags and gloves too. If I find broken objects or containers with unknown contents, I will not open them myself but tell the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the bags and gloves and report broken objects or containers with unknown contents to the person in charge without opening them yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋と手袋はこちらの受付机でお渡しします。割れた物や中身のわからない容器は拾わず、区画と見た位置をこの受付へ知らせてください。ご自身で開けたり動かしたりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will give you bags and gloves at this reception desk. Do not pick up broken objects or containers with unknown contents; tell this desk the section and the location where you saw them. Do not open or move them yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一緒に来た友人にも説明を聞いてもらいます。私が聞いた一部だけで、別の場所の作業を指示しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人にも説明を聞いてもらい、自分が聞いた一部だけで別の場所の作業を指示しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will have the friend who came with me hear the explanation too. I will not direct work in another area based only on the part I heard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will have your friend hear the explanation too and will not direct work in another location based only on the part you heard. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご友人も一緒に受付で説明を聞いてください。A区画以外の作業は、見かけた人のまねで始めず、その場所の担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please have your friend hear the explanation at reception with you. Do not start work outside section A by copying people you see; check with the person in charge of that area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当範囲、袋、手袋、報告先を確かめます。危ない物は触らず、指示された範囲で活動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 範囲、袋、手袋、報告先を確認し、危険な物には触らず指示された範囲で活動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm my assigned area, bags, gloves and reporting contact. I will not touch dangerous objects and will work within the area instructed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the area, bags, gloves and reporting contact, avoid touching dangerous items, and work within the assigned area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お二人そろってから、地図でA区画と報告先をもう一度確認しましょう。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01230-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Once you are both here, let us check section A and the reporting point on the map again. Thank you for your help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。移動のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your travel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 恵庭から旅行へ自転車を持って行きたいです。列車に持ち込む条件を確認する窓口を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車を旅行へ持参したいので、列車への持込み条件を確認する窓口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take my bicycle on a trip from Eniwa. Please tell me which desk can confirm the conditions for bringing it on a train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to check the conditions for bringing a bicycle on a train because you want to take it on your trip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの列車を利用し、どのように運ぶ予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which train will you take, and how do you plan to carry it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旅行の列車は決めましたが、袋はまだ買っていません。車輪を外せば必ず乗せられるとは思わず、条件を先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車は決めたが袋は未購入で、車輪を外せば必ず持ち込めるとは考えず、先に条件を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have chosen my train, but have not bought a bag yet. I do not assume removing the wheels guarantees I can bring it aboard; I want to ask the conditions first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have chosen the train but not bought a bag and want to check conditions first, without assuming removing the wheels guarantees acceptance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用する事業者の手荷物条件を担当へ確認しましょう。自転車の寸法はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the person in charge about the operator's baggage conditions. Do you know the bicycle's dimensions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 組み立てた時の寸法しか測っていません。収納した状態の大きさや重量も必要か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 組立時の寸法しか測っていないので、収納時の大きさや重量も必要か尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have only measured it assembled. I would like to ask whether its packed dimensions and weight are needed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have only measured the bicycle assembled and want to ask whether its packed dimensions and weight are also required. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報を確認してから袋や移動方法を選べます。混雑時の扱いも問い合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can choose a bag and transport method after confirming the information required. Please also ask about arrangements during crowded periods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 旅行先で借りる方法も比べます。持ち込みだけに決めて、当日改札で困るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持込みに決めつけず現地で借りる方法も比べ、当日改札で困らないようにしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also compare renting at my destination. I want to avoid committing only to taking mine and then having trouble at the ticket gate on the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare renting at the destination rather than committing to bringing your bicycle, to avoid problems at the gate on the day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれの利用条件と、ご自身で運べるかを考えて選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Consider the conditions of each option and whether you can carry it yourself before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 列車の条件と収納寸法を確認し、現地で借りる候補も調べます。袋を買う前に方法を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 事業者の条件と収納寸法、現地で借りる候補を調べ、袋を買う前に移動方法を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the train conditions and packed dimensions, and research rental options at the destination too. I want to decide how to do it before buying a bag.
